title: nan
authors: Ashwin I.; Rajagopal M.; Naren M.; Narayan V.S.; Murugan B.
key_contribution: Presents an autonomous indoor drone navigation system for GPS-denied environments using the Nav2 framework and SLAM Toolbox in ROS/Gazebo simulation, with obstacle traversal.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
